commits.message:
fix(router): a request holds its session's view at its own context, so it needs nothing to outlive the config turn before it (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5zx)

The request turn held whatever view it found, so a view closed between
the config turn and the request turn (an eviction) failed the request,
and a request delivered after a later config drew that config's context
beside its own hints. It now holds the view at the context it carries,
as the config turn opened it: a view still open is kept, and one closed
since opens again. The request event's effects are the request turn's
alone; a config turn's are refused on their own effect-done.

fix(router): a request holds the view its config turn opened, and the config turn records the context it carries (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5zx)

The request turn opened the session's view a second time at its own
context, so a request delivered after a later config moved the view back
to the older context. It now holds the view the config turn opened and
opens nothing. The config turn records the request's hints and config
inputs before it opens, so a session whose opening throws still names
the chain a durable click resolves. Every effect a config turn returns
is refused, so none is left owed its effect-done, and its failure is
named by the turn, not by a guessed cause.

feat(router): a session's config turn reaches the renderer ahead of its request, so the request waits on every source its view reads (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5zx)

The host delivers a config event before each request. Its turn opens the
session's view, and its output's subscriptions are declared before the
request is delivered, so a plugin source's first read is waited for
instead of drawn pending. The config event is the one carrier of a
session's context with its world state; the request carries none. The
host reads the checkout's location once, for both turns.
docs(design): a run's identity carries the sharing, with named environment variables and a session's config ahead of its request (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8e9)

docs(design): per-directory sharing of shell and file sources once the host runs them (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8e9)

The options for keeping a directory's sources shared after 8e9 moves runs to
the host, what each buys and costs, and where the ticket stands.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.216.0
